marc:datafield.marc:subfield: THE ALPHA WOMAN MEETS HER MATCH : How Today's Strong Woman Can Find Love and Happiness Without Settling

In the twenty-first century, women are outpacing men in education and career advancement. Yet amazingly, successful women constantly hear that their professional achievements doom their chances of marriage and family. Do not believe the alarmist hype. Today’s Alpha women, ambitious, self-assured, and hardworking, are not going to end up lonely spinsters. They do not have to settle for Mr. Good-Enough. This book shares the secret necessary to triumph in love and work : find the right partner. It can be done and this book has the tools to help. Going beyond value judgments associated with the terms Alpha and Beta, This book advises women to look past the overly competitive, domineering Alpha male for a man who’s in touch with his inner Beta qualities, someone who is communicative, responsible, thoughtful, and collaborative. Demonstrating that most people are a combination of both sets of qualities, she includes a revealing test to help readers define where they (and their partners) are on the Alpha-Beta spectrum.
